item.title: Rabbi Shais Taub Tribute to His Mother
item.description: On the occasion of the shloshim of his mother Rivkah Taub obm, Rabbi Shais Taub delivered a lecture sharing personal memories and reflections on her life as a speech therapist, her extraordinary resilience and positivity, and the lasting impact she had on him and many others. Full Story, Video

item.title: How Can I Get to the Siyum Harambam?
item.description: Building on the success of last year’s initiative, the Siyum organizers have arranged free transportation for the Crown Heights, East Flatbush, and Remsen Village communities to ensure that everyone can participate in this historic event at the Bedford Union Armory. Full Story
